title: Jorge was the best!
text: We had only a few hours to see Barcelona, since it was a quick stop in our cruise, but Jorge is an expert and he made sure we saw the best places. He is very knowledgeable and mapped out the best route. We ended up having tapas in a local hole in the wall spot here recommended that was Amazing!! 10/10
author: Valerie_G

title: Barcelona 1/2 Day Barcelona
text: Very Knowledgeable. Custom Tour Stopped when we wanted to at different sights. Informative at each stop
author: Susan_C

title: Wonderful relaxing way to see Barcelona
text:
This was our first private tour and we’ll definitely be doing it again. We had a five hour layover from when our cruise ship docked in Barcelona and when our flight was scheduled to leave. We thought about just hanging out at the airport, but it seemed a shame to miss out on spending some time in Barcelona.

title: Fabulous!  Excellent Tour!
text: The Tour was fabulous!  We would recommend the tour company to everyone.  The driver/tour guide arrived on time and was knowledgeable about Barcelona. We enjoyed the tour!  Thanks for the experience.
author: Dudley_C

title: Awesome tour.
text: Our driver Hassan was wonderful. He arrived on time to the airport. He was very courteous and personable. I had no itinerary and he showed us all around Barcelona. He was very friendly and took us to the cruise port safely and on time. I would definitely recommend.
author: Tania_P
